description: Full SellerHome dashboard, DriverDashboard, and AdminDashboard screens. Replaces the stubs from FEAT-002 with complete, functional role dashboards. These three screens are independent of each other (no shared state) and are grouped into one FEAT to keep feature count manageable. Depends on FEAT-002 (stubs must exist so this is a replace, not create).
steps: 1. screens/SellerHome.js — Full rewrite. Keep the existing SafeAreaView/ScrollView shell and the signOut button. Add the following sections: (a) Header: show dbUser.firstName + ' ' + dbUser.lastName, a role badge (Restaurant / Shop based on dbUser.role), and an approval status chip (APPROVED green, PENDING amber, REJECTED red). Use brand color #179B83 for approved, #F47721 for pending. (b) Stats row: query orders collection where restaurantId == dbUser.sellerId AND createdAt >= start of today (Firestore Timestamp.fromDate(new Date(new Date().setHours(0,0,0,0)))). Show: Today's orders (count), Today's revenue (sum of order.total, displayed as 'ETB X'), Pending orders (count where status=='PENDING'). Fetch with getDocs on mount and on pull-to-refresh. (c) Live orders list: onSnapshot query orders where restaurantId == dbUser.sellerId, orderBy createdAt desc, limit 20. Unsubscribe on unmount. (d) Each order card shows: customer name (order.customerName || order.userId), items summary (order.items is an array — show count), total in ETB, a status badge with color (PENDING amber, ACCEPTED/PREPARING green, READY blue, DECLINED/CANCELLED red). Action buttons: PENDING state shows 'Accept' (updateDoc sets status ACCEPTED) and 'Decline' (sets status DECLINED). ACCEPTED or PREPARING state shows 'Mark Ready' (sets status READY). Other statuses show status text only. All updateDoc calls include updatedAt: serverTimestamp(). (e) Pull-to-refresh on ScrollView (RefreshControl). (f) Empty state: icon (MaterialCommunityIcons 'inbox-outline' size 48 color #94A3B8) + 'No orders yet' text + 'Refresh' button. (g) Error state: text + 'Try again' button that re-runs the stats fetch. (h) Sign out button at bottom using signOutUser from UserAuth(). Imports needed: collection, query, where, onSnapshot, getDocs, updateDoc, doc, serverTimestamp, orderBy, limit, Timestamp from 'firebase/firestore'; db from '../firebase'; UserAuth from '../contexts/AuthContext'; RefreshControl, ActivityIndicator from 'react-native'; MaterialCommunityIcons from '@expo/vector-icons/MaterialCommunityIcons'.

2. screens/DriverDashboard.js — Full implementation replacing the stub. Structure: (a) Header: 'Driver Dashboard' title + driver name (dbUser.firstName) + an Online/Offline toggle (Switch component). Toggle calls updateDoc(doc(db,'user',user.uid), {isOnline: value, updatedAt: serverTimestamp()}). Read initial isOnline from dbUser.isOnline. (b) When online — 'Available Orders' section: query orders where status=='READY'. For the driverId field absence filter, use query(ordersRef, where('status','==','READY'), where('driverId','==',null)) — note: orders created without a driverId field won't match; also try a second getDocs with where('driverId','==','') and merge results client-side if needed. Refresh on a 30-second interval using setInterval (not onSnapshot, to avoid excessive reads on a potentially large collection). Each available order card shows: restaurantName (order.restaurantName), deliveryAddress (order.deliveryAddress || order.address || 'Address not set'), total ETB, 'Accept Delivery' button — updateDoc({driverId: user.uid, status: 'DRIVERACCEPTED', updatedAt: serverTimestamp()}). (c) 'Active Delivery' section: onSnapshot query orders where driverId==user.uid AND status in ['DRIVERACCEPTED','DRIVERPICKEDUP']. Each active card shows: customer name, delivery address, 'Picked Up' button (DRIVERACCEPTED→DRIVERPICKEDUP) and 'Complete Delivery' button (DRIVERPICKEDUP→COMPLETE). (d) Earnings summary: getDocs query orders where driverId==user.uid AND status==COMPLETE — show count and sum of total (ETB). Fetch on mount and refresh. (e) Sign out button using signOutUser. (f) Loading, empty, and error states for each section. Use ActivityIndicator color='#179B83' for loading. (g) Brand colors throughout. Imports: Switch, ScrollView, RefreshControl, ActivityIndicator from 'react-native'; SafeAreaView from 'react-native-safe-area-context'; collection, query, where, onSnapshot, getDocs, updateDoc, doc, serverTimestamp, orderBy from 'firebase/firestore'; db from '../firebase'; UserAuth from '../contexts/AuthContext'; MaterialCommunityIcons from '@expo/vector-icons/MaterialCommunityIcons'.

3. screens/AdminDashboard.js — Full implementation replacing the stub. Structure: (a) Header: 'Admin Dashboard' title + sign out button. (b) Platform stats: fetch on mount with Promise.all of five getDocs calls: users (collection 'user', filter by role=='customer'), restaurants (collection 'restaurants'), shops (collection 'shops'), drivers (collection 'user', filter role=='driver'), orders (collection 'orders'). Display counts in a 2-column grid of stat cards: Total Customers, Restaurants, Shops, Drivers, Total Orders. Show ActivityIndicator while loading. (c) Pending Approvals section: getDocs query restaurants where status=='PENDING' plus getDocs query shops where status=='PENDING'. Show combined list. Each approval card: business name, type badge (Restaurant / Shop), owner (doc.ownerName || doc.ownerId), Approve button (updateDoc({status:'APPROVED', updatedAt: serverTimestamp()})) and Reject button (updateDoc({status:'REJECTED', updatedAt: serverTimestamp()})). Approve is #179B83, Reject is #F47721. (d) Recent Orders section: getDocs query orders orderBy createdAt desc limit 10. Show each order as a compact row: orderId (first 8 chars), restaurantName, status badge, total ETB. (e) RefreshControl on ScrollView for pull-to-refresh of all sections. (f) Error state with retry button. (g) Brand colors. Imports: collection, query, where, getDocs, updateDoc, doc, serverTimestamp, orderBy, limit from 'firebase/firestore'; db from '../firebase'; UserAuth from '../contexts/AuthContext'; ScrollView, RefreshControl, ActivityIndicator, View, Text, TouchableOpacity from 'react-native'; SafeAreaView from 'react-native-safe-area-context'.
acceptance_criteria: SellerHome shows a stats row, live orders list with action buttons, empty state, error state, and pull-to-refresh.
DriverDashboard shows online/offline toggle, available orders, active delivery, and earnings — all with loading and empty states.
AdminDashboard shows platform stats grid, pending approvals with approve/reject buttons, and recent orders list.
All three screens use brand colors (#179B83, #F47721, #0B2A26, #F5FAF9) throughout.
updateDoc calls compile and reference doc(db, 'collection', id) correctly with serverTimestamp() for updatedAt.
npx expo config --type introspect completes without error.
